paras: The two examples on this double-page spread show compositions reduced to a few elements: above, wrapping papers with different colors and structures; to the right, unpainted, painted, and textured papers with contrasted, torn, and cut surfaces and minimal color contrasts.
Below: weighted under a sheet of glass, the work can be observed without distracting, curling surfaces and shadows. Additional elements such as paints can be tested on the glass.
